name: Dot Connect
description: Join matching dots with lines that never cross, and fill every square of the board.
author: Koda Learning Lab
tagline: Join the pairs, fill the board.

features.name: Play together
features.description: Friends race the same lesson with the same questions. XP and stars still come from each child's own answers.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the lesson opening, the hint line and the question when the speaker is pressed.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a pop when a pair is joined, and the solved sound.

features.name: Haptic feedback
features.description: Pairs a joined line and a solved board with device feedback.

features.name: Smart guide
features.description: Offers the lesson tip, the colour to work on and its route when a learner stalls, and outlines the dot to start from.

features.name: Smart guide voice
features.description: Reads each Smart guide step aloud as it appears. Off, the guide stays visible and silent.

features.name: Move hints
features.description: Three rungs: the lesson's own tip, then what to look at on this board, then a line's route.

features.name: Step framing tags
features.description: Labels warm-up, challenge and milestone steps.

features.name: Charge for later lessons
features.description: Keeps a configurable number of lessons free.

settingsSchema.label: Smart guide patience
settingsSchema.help: How long a learner is left to plan before the Smart guide steps in.

settingsSchema.label: Free lessons
settingsSchema.help: Number of lessons available before a plan is needed.
